title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
platDesc: Earn all FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE trophies.

trophies.name: Materia for Beginners
trophies.desc: Level up an orb of materia.

trophies.name: Biker Boy
trophies.desc: Get praised by Jessie at the end of the motorcycle mini-game.

trophies.name: Heavenly Dart Player
trophies.desc: Rise to the top of the Seventh Heaven darts leaderboard.

trophies.name: In Lockstep
trophies.desc: Bypass the delta-level security lock in Mako Reactor 5.

trophies.name: Crate Annihilator
trophies.desc: Complete all Normal difficulty Whack-a-Box challenges.

trophies.name: Say It with Flowers
trophies.desc: Decorate the Leaf House with a floral arrangement.

trophies.name: Dancing Queen
trophies.desc: Received a gift from Andrea for being a dance superstar.

trophies.name: Returning Champion
trophies.desc: Emerge victorious from a colosseum sparring session.

trophies.name: Dressed to the Nines
trophies.desc: Obtain all nine bridal candidate outfits.

trophies.name: Whack-a-Box Wunderkind
trophies.desc: Complete all Hard difficulty Whack-a-Box challenges.

trophies.name: Divine Gratitude
trophies.desc: Receive a letter from an angel.

trophies.name: Staggering Feat
trophies.desc: Deal 300% damage to a staggered enemy.

trophies.name: Ultimate Weapon
trophies.desc: Defeat the Pride and Joy prototype.

trophies.name: Hardened Veteran
trophies.desc: Complete all chapters on Hard difficulty.

trophies.name: The Road to Revenge
trophies.desc: Complete both chapters of INTERmission on Hard difficulty.

trophies.name: Turtle-tastic
trophies.desc: Collect all the Happy Turtle flyers.

trophies.name: Condor Queen
trophies.desc: Become the Fort Condor grandmaster on Hard difficulty.

trophies.name: Materia Maven
trophies.desc: Obtain all materia available from Shinra Box Buster challenges.

trophies.name: Ultimate Weapon 2.0
trophies.desc: Defeat the Pride and Joy Mk 0.5.

developer: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I
